label: The universe has a cause: UniverseHasExistingCause o F w:= ∃ c, o.ExistsAt w c ∧ o.Causes w c…
term: the universe has a cause (of its existence)
definition: `UniverseHasExistingCause o F w := ∃ c, o.ExistsAt w c ∧ o.Causes w c F.whole`: the spacetime whole has a cause that exists at w. `Causes` is efficient causation of existence (dependence or conservation, as in ST I q.104 a.1), not the cause of a temporal beginning and not a PSR-style reason (DISAMB-PSR-EXPLANATION-CAUSE).
note: Owner formulation (#1109, 2026-11-06), stipulative. Kept independent of the kalam premise: Aquinas holds that a beginning of the world is not demonstrable (ST I q.46 a.2).
